essence: The efficacy of mantra and yantra depends on the stated condition being fulfilled.
Matters concerning the guru are subject to strict and perpetual secrecy.
Transmission is restricted to qualified recipients, especially the devoted and noble-born.
The disciple must receive the declared teaching with careful attention and firm understanding.
Meditation requires visualizing the guru in a specific auspicious and pleasing form.
